summary: First-run full-stack test of inclusiv.ai. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases passed (auth, students CRUD, exams list/detail/photo-OCR upload via Gemini vision, adaptations create/list/get/edit/approve with guide-normalization verified, PDF/TXT export, OpenAI TTS mp3). Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): onboarding -> login (prefilled demo creds) -> home shows non-zero stats (Provas=7, Adaptações=5, Alunos=3) -> Provas tab lists Matemática + Português + previously uploaded photo exams -> Adaptar opens profile screen with all expected testIDs -> Alunos tab shows Ana/Bruno/Clara, add-student modal creates TEST UI Student successfully -> Conta tab signout button present -> /new/upload renders all three source cards (pdf/camera/gallery). No red-screen errors. Only one minor UI gap: profile chips inside the add-student modal lack per-profile testIDs. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.

ui_bugs.issue: Profile selection chips inside the new-student modal do not expose per-profile testIDs (expected pattern: student-profile-{id}, e.g. student-profile-dislexia). Chips render and are clickable, but automated per-profile selection cannot target a specific disability.

action_items: Add testID={`student-profile-${p.id}`} to each profile chip inside the add-student bottom-sheet modal in app/(tabs)/students.tsx so automated flows can toggle specific profiles.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 886 lines — consider splitting into routers/ (auth, exams, adaptations, export) and a services/ layer once the app grows further; still readable for an MVP.

_TTS_CACHE is in-process memory only — audio URLs become 404 after a backend restart; acceptable for MVP but document the limitation (consider persisting to GridFS or disk if load-balancing is added).
/api/adaptations/{aid}/approve response_model is missing; it just returns {ok: true}. Fine for now but inconsistent with the rest of the API that uses Pydantic models.
GEMINI_FALLBACK is defined but never used — add fallback logic or remove the constant.
Normalization helpers (_to_str/_str_list/_normalize_adaptation) are solid and successfully coerce AI output into strings — guide/questoes_adaptadas always have string items (verified in tests).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; one minor missing testID)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Backend startup seed already provisions demo user (professor@inclusiv.ai), 2 demo exams (Matemática 6º, Português 7º) and 3 students (Ana, Bruno, Clara). A TEST UI Student was created during the UI run and persists in the demo account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py covers the full backend surface including the slow Gemini-OCR exam upload and Gemini-adapt + TTS calls (completes in ~50s). Public URL is https://app-mobile-lab-6.preview.emergentagent.com; env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Frontend tabs: route paths are /, /exams, /students, /account (observed via get_by_text clicks staying on '/'; use direct URL goto for robust tests, or click bottom tab bar via Pressable role). The AI guide-items normalization fix is working — all guide fields come back as list[str] in GET /api/adaptations.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs encountered during this run.
